description: This PHP class defines an LDAPSetting data transfer object (DTO) for LDAP configuration in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for LDAP server details, binding options, user lookup settings, data mapping, and synchronization options, along with methods for constructing, serializing, and manipulating these settings.

classes.name: LDAPSetting
classes.description: A data transfer object that encapsulates LDAP configuration settings such as server details, security options, user data mapping, and synchronization preferences for the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new LDAPSetting instance with specified host, port, implementation, and encryption parameters.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates an LDAPSetting instance from a JSON-encoded string representation of the configuration.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Serializes the LDAPSetting instance into a JSON string, encrypting the password if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Retrieves the LDAP server host.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the LDAP server host.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Retrieves the LDAP server port.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the LDAP server port.

methods.name: getEncryption
methods.description: Retrieves the encryption method used.

methods.name: setEncryption
methods.description: Sets the encryption method, validating input.

methods.name: getImplementation
methods.description: Retrieves the LDAP implementation type.

methods.name: setImplementation
methods.description: Sets the LDAP implementation type, validating input.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the LDAP protocol version.

methods.name: setVersion
methods.description: Sets the LDAP protocol version.

methods.name: isOptReferrals
methods.description: Checks if LDAP referrals are opt-in.

methods.name: setOptReferrals
methods.description: Enables or disables LDAP referrals.

methods.name: isBindAnonymously
methods.description: Checks if LDAP bind is anonymous.

methods.name: setBindAnonymously
methods.description: Sets LDAP anonymous bind.

methods.name: getBindUserDN
methods.description: Gets the distinguished name for bound user.

methods.name: setBindUserDN
methods.description: Sets the distinguished name for bound user.

methods.name: getBindUserPassword
methods.description: Gets the password for bound user.

methods.name: setBindUserPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for bound user.

methods.name: isEnable
methods.description: Checks if LDAP settings are enabled.

methods.name: setEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables LDAP settings.

methods.name: shouldMergeLDAPUsersWithExistingSystemUsers
methods.description: Checks if LDAP users are to be merged with existing system users.

methods.name: setMergeLDAPUsersWithExistingSystemUsers
methods.description: Sets whether to merge LDAP users with existing system users.

methods.name: getSyncInterval
methods.description: Retrieves the synchronization interval.

methods.name: setSyncInterval
methods.description: Sets the synchronization interval.

methods.name: getDataMapping
methods.description: Retrieves the LDAP user data mapping object.

methods.name: getUserLookupSettings
methods.description: Retrieves the list of LDAP user lookup settings.

methods.name: addUserLookupSetting
methods.description: Adds a new LDAP user lookup setting.
